messages.subject: PhD position available
parts:
Folks,

 

A PhD position is now available in my lab.  Current research in the lab centers on the interface between morphometrics and phylogenetic comparative biology, morphological evolution in vertebrates, and permutation theory.

 

Prospective graduate students interested in geometric morphometrics, macroevolution, and evolutionary/statistical theory are encouraged to apply through the Ecology & Evolutionary Biology (EEB) graduate program (https://www.eeb.iastate.edu/). Successful applicants may develop an independent research project within these areas, or one that complements or extends other research in the lab. For more information about the research in our lab please visit our website: https://faculty.sites.iastate.edu/dcadams/

 

Interested candidates should contact Dr. Dean Adams at dca...@iastate.edu. 

 

Dean
